result_text:
I fixed the "past 90d" block. It now shows the main LOC of repositories with commits in the past 90 days. Before, it showed the 180-day figure.

The fix is one word in `LandscapeReportGenerator.java` (`addBigRepositoriesSummary`, around line 906 in the `reports` module): the block's LOC text used `loc180Days` and now uses `loc90Days`. The repository count and percentage already used the 90-day values.

The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests and didn't add one for your 500 / 2,000 LOC example.
